parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with null bytes in file paths but lacks broader context and testing.

issues.description: The patch only addresses the specific case of null bytes in file paths and does not provide a comprehensive solution or explanation for the root cause.
There are no additional tests provided to verify the effectiveness of the patch in different scenarios or to ensure it does not introduce new issues.
The patch introduces a new condition check that is not consistent with the existing code style and conventions.
